description: Defines the CacCapabilities interface for querying CAC (Channel Access Control) capabilities of an agent, including methods for retrieving country code, radios, supported CAC methods, CAC durations, and operating classes. Also includes utility functions and type definitions related to CAC capabilities.

classes.name: CacCapabilities
classes.description: Interface class for querying CAC capabilities of an agent, with methods to get country code, radios, support for specific CAC methods, CAC durations, and operating classes.

methods.name: get_country_code
methods.description: Returns the ISO 3166 country code where the agent is operating.

methods.name: get_cac_radios
methods.description: Returns a list of radios (MAC addresses) that can perform CAC.

methods.name: is_cac_method_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific CAC method is supported on a given radio.

methods.name: get_cac_completion_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in seconds for a radio to complete CAC scan using a specified method.

methods.name: get_cac_operating_classes
methods.description: Returns a map of operating classes to channels for a given radio and CAC method.
